items.summary: The deal, partially funded through the U.S. BEAD program, will bring fast, secure, and reliable connectivity to underserved communities in southeast Georgia.

items.title: AI agents raise new control questions for telecom networks
items.summary: As AI agents move from network recommendations to real-time actions, telcos face a high-stakes governance question. Nokia, Ericsson and Samsung weigh in.

items.title: Nokia’s AI-RAN pitch gets reality check in new study
items.summary: A newly commissioned study for the Finnish vendor takes a closer look at Nokia’s AI-RAN spectral efficiency claims and sets parameters for how they will best be achieved.

items.title: How secure testing supports open RAN collaboration
items.summary: Shared testing can accelerate open RAN, but vendor data and intellectual property must remain protected.

items.title: Fierce Network Innovation Awards open for entries: Showcase real-world impact across telecom
items.summary: The Fierce Network Innovation Awards are accepting entries through Sept. 11 at Early Bird rates, recognizing deployments, technologies and partnerships that are delivering measurable results across telecom, broadband, cloud and AI.

items.title: T-Mobile CTO: AI is making disaster response faster, smarter
items.summary: T-Mobile CTO John Saw said AI is helping his network adapt faster when disasters strike so that customers will be able to use the network when they need it most.

items.title: Opinion: Huawei trial opens in Brooklyn as DOJ drops some charges
items.summary: Huawei's landmark RICO trial opens with the DOJ quietly trimming parts of its case, as a U.S. victory could disrupt communications and financial infrastructure across the developing world.
